presentation.description:
A growing collection of FFXIV quality-of-life tweaks, each in its own settings tab:

- Hotbar Helper: when you open Actions & Traits, scans your hotbars against your current job and shows any actions or role actions you haven't slotted anywhere — then drag an icon straight onto a hotbar slot to assign it.
- Submarines: FC submarine status with per-sub EXP bars, plus a tabbed voyage route planner — EXP/hour levelling routes (with fuel cost), exploration routes that reveal the most still-undiscovered locations, and gil-farming routes (per-sub gil/hour, build and rank requirements) — with one-click apply, optional unlock-progression routing, and auto-repair.
- Leves: automated craft (tradecraft) leve hand-ins — pick a leve, stand at the counter, and it accepts and turns in until your allowance floor or items run out.
- Expert Delivery: adds a "Turn in all" button to the Grand Company Expert Delivery window that hands in every listed item and confirms each delivery for you.
- Glamour Sync: keeps a gear set's portrait matching its gear — after a glamour plate, a job change, or equipping Recommended Gear — so the "portrait doesn't match" warning stays gone.

Dalamud plugin repository for DashaTweaks (install manifest + releases). # DashaTweaks — Dalamud plugin repository

This is the install repository for **DashaTweaks**, a Dalamud (FFXIV) plugin
with a growing collection of quality-of-life tweaks (hotbar audit, submarine
route planning, craft-leve hand-ins).

## How to install in-game

1. Make sure you have [XIVLauncher / Dalamud](https://goatcorp.github.io/) set up.
2. In-game, open the Dalamud settings with `/xlsettings`.
3. Go to the **Experimental** tab.
4. Under **Custom Plugin Repositories**, paste this URL into an empty row:

   ```
   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DashaDaymoon/DashaTweaksRepo/main/pluginmaster.json
   ```

5. Click the **+** to add it, then click **Save and Close** (the floppy-disk icon).
6. Open the plugin installer with `/xlplugins`, search for **DashaTweaks**, and
   click **Install**.

Updates show up in `/xlplugins` automatically whenever a new version is released here.

## Features

See the in-game plugin description, or the [Punchline](pluginmaster.json) in the manifest.

## Notes

This repository hosts only the installable build and its manifest. Each release
on this repo's [Releases page](https://github.com/DashaDaymoon/DashaTweaksRepo/releases)
contains `latest.zip` (the packaged plugin).
